newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Wing Tai raises stake in HK property firm.
newsitem.headline: Wing Tai raises stake in HK property firm.

text.p: Diviersified property group Wing Tai Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it has bought a further 16.21 million shares in Hong Kong-listed Winsor Properties Holdings Ltd as a long-term investment.
Wing Tai said in a statement it bought the additional 12.48 percent of Windsor's issued share capital for HK$296.3 million.
The purchase took Wing Tai's stake to 31.59 million shares, or 24.33 percent of Winsor's issued share capital. The shares were bought at an average cost of HK$15.30 per share, the statement said.
Winsor has valued its net tangible assets at HK$23.72 per share, it added.
Based on this valuation, the interest in Winsor would increase the consolidated net tangible assets of Wing Tai by about Singapore nine cents per share, it said.

Winsor owns various industrial buildings, godowns and redevelopment sites in Hong Kong. It also owns a 5.28 percent interest in Singapore's Suntec City Development Pte Ltd and the ninth floor of an office block at Suntec City.
